lookup_element_by_symbol: use SYMBOLS dict to look up an Element object by its chemical symbol like 'Fe' or 'C'
lookup_element_by_atomic_number: use ATOMIC_NUMS dict to look up an Element object by its atomic number like 26 for iron
get_element_group: call the group property on an Element to get its periodic table group number
get_element_spin_config: call the spin_config property on an Element to get the number of unpaired electrons in its ground state
get_element_alpha_beta_electrons: call the nalpha and nbeta properties on an Element to get alpha and beta electron counts
